caption: A dolphin, a snail, and a bat. Only one of these is made up, and it is the one absolutely everybody believes. Your kid probably knows this one and you don't. Guess before the reveal.

carousel.hook: You've believed this since you were 6.

carousel.caption: Bats are blind, right? Real or fake. Three facts, one of them is a lie, and it is the one everybody believes. From Trick Trivia, a real-or-fake guessing game book for kids ages 7 to 13: 210 facts across animals, the human body, space, history and more, with full-colour comic illustrations on every page. It is the screen-free game for road trips, restaurants and family nights, and the reason kids love it is that they beat their parents. Comment your score out of 3.
